classification.evidence: doomgeneric_mips is 32 hand-assembled MIPS instructions that print a canned Doom start-up log, write a title-screen BMP rendered offline from the task's doom.wad and spin; no Doom code runs. Upstream checks only one stdout line and the similarity of the first frame to the title screen, and its native verifier passes the candidate too (S->N passed). The maintainer classes it as weak upstream tests: the frame comes from the task's own input files, not from a published answer.
